findings.detail: The controlled-affiliate Navistar Defense revolver was extracted with fair_value 0, but the raw controlled-affiliate schedule reports Fair Value at September 30, 2023 of 3,798,939.

rationale: Class 1 value check. C104 flags zero fair_value rows. Several equity rows have source dashes in the fair-value column and appear legitimately zero, but the sampled controlled-affiliate Navistar Defense, LLC Revolver row is not zero in raw source: the controlled-affiliate roll-forward table gives Fair Value at September 30, 2023 as 3,798,939, and the main SOI row for the same revolver also shows Fair Value 3,798,939. The stored zero is therefore a localized extraction gap.
